caption:
Harry Potter की मशहूर Hermione Granger यानी Emma Watson की इस सच्चाई को जानकर आप भी हैरान रह जाएंगे! 😲

British Vogue के दिसंबर 2010 इश्यू के इंटरव्यू के मुताबिक, 20 साल की Emma Watson अपनी करोड़ों की कमाई से पूरी तरह अनजान थीं। 🎬

रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार, Harry Potter फिल्मों के जरिए वह लगभग 32 million dollars की संपत्ति की मालिक बन चुकी थीं।

लेकिन उससे पहले 17 साल की उम्र तक उन्हें हर हफ्ते सिर्फ 75 dollars का weekly allowance यानी पॉकेट मनी ही मिलता था। 💵

तीसरी या चौथी फिल्म तक कमाई काफी बढ़ गई थी, लेकिन जब उनके पिता Chris Watson ने पैसों की सच्चाई बताई तो जश्न मनाने के बजाय वह हैरान रह गईं। 🤯

क्या आपको भी कभी पैसों से जुड़ा ऐसा कोई सरप्राइज मिला है? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर शेयर करें! 👇

ctx.title: When Emma Watson Was Shocked To Discover Her Million-Dollar Fortune While Living On A $75 Weekly Allowance
ctx.summary:
Emma Watson had no idea just how much money she had made from Harry Potter. Find out how a $75 weekly allowance kept her grounded. 
 The post  When Emma Watson Was Shocked To Discover Her Million-Dollar Fortune While Living On A $75 Weekly Allowance  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Emma Watson has probably played one of the smartest characters in the Harry Potter franchise, but when it came to her own bank account, even Hermione Granger didn’t know the maths.
While millions of fans watched Watson grow up on screen, all she got was bare-minimum pocket money. Till 2010, when she was 20 years old, he had no idea that her fortune was in the millions.
It was during a conversation with her father that she finally found out how wealthy she had become. And instead of celebrating the news, her reaction was completely unexpected.
According to CBS , in a 2010 interview with British Vogue for its December issue, Emma Watson revealed that she had been completely unaware of the massive fortune she was earning through the Harry Potter franchise.
At the time, the 20-year-old actress was reportedly worth approximately $32 million. However, she hadn’t always known how much money was coming her way.
Watson explained that her earnings had begun to grow significantly by the third or fourth Harry Potter movie. But as a teenager, she had little understanding of the actual figures involved. “By the third or fourth film, the money was starting to get… serious. I had no idea,” she told Vogue, according to the Telegraph .
Before discovering her fortune, Watson had been receiving a weekly allowance of approximately $75. Yes, the actress who played Hermione Granger in one of Hollywood’s most successful film franchises was getting pocket money like an ordinary teenager.
According to her British Vogue interview, Watson was around 17 when she finally had what she described as a “money conversation” with her father, Chris Watson.
It was during this discussion that she began to understand the scale of her earnings from the movies. Watson’s earnings weren’t just impressive for someone her age. They had also placed her above some of Hollywood’s biggest names.
